title: REQ · Books and secret door states exist as separate object assets
summary: Books object and secret-door closed/open state SVGs registered in the manifest
description: Context: objects folder has computer, door and window only. Desired behavior: a books object and two secret door state images (closed, open) as separate files with manifest entries. Expected result: persistent door state can switch textures. Why: the bookshelf secret door must stay open on return.
acceptance_criteria: Given the manifest, when read, then objects/books, objects/secret-door-closed and objects/secret-door-open exist
Given each SVG, when its size is read, then it equals manifest dimensions
Given both secret door states, when compared, then they have identical dimensions and different content

out_of_scope: object state logic in content YAML

technical_constraints: Both door states share one size
